disclaimer: This is general information, not veterinary advice.
disclaimerLong: This app summarises published veterinary sources. It does not examine your animal, it cannot account for their size, age or health, and it is not a substitute for a veterinary professional. If you think your pet has eaten something harmful, call a vet or a poison control line — do not wait to see what happens.
sourcesPolicyBody: Every entry cites at least two independent authoritative sources. Where good sources disagree, or coverage is thin, we leave the entry out rather than guess — which is why you will sometimes get "Not sure".
